methods.name: Sparse Feature Refinement Module
methods.description: SFR module where each box is cropped to W=200 and H=200 from input samples and randomly positioned on a square canvas

methods.name: Offline Implementation of SFR
methods.description: Pre-processes data before training by randomly shuffling all bounding boxes from the dataset, selecting 16 boxes at a time for canvas filling to generate samples of sizes 2×2, 3×3, and 4×4, and merging them with original images.

methods.name: Online approach
methods.description: Directly processes input data to obtain scaled-down data during batch generation.

methods.name: AGP
methods.description: Proposed method designed to address adapter adaptation issues and prevent the model from getting trapped in suboptimal solutions or forgetting prior knowledge on camouflaged object detection tasks.
